description: Compact sequence-free per-case provenance evidence extracted from raw TEagle manifests.
excluded_field_classes: raw nucleotide and amino-acid sequences, previews, motifs, and primers
ORFs, domain hit payloads, and unbounded nested detector output
free-text result explanations and source citations

hash_semantics.input_sha256: SHA-256 of the fetch-level FASTA text supplied by the benchmark runner, including its header and text representation.
hash_semantics.internal_manifest_sha256: Recomputed and verified TEagle content-addressed manifest seal.
hash_semantics.relationship: These hashes cover different representations and are expected to differ; they must not be equated.
hash_semantics.sealed_input_sha256: SHA-256 of the analysed residue string recorded inside TEagle's content-addressed manifest.
hash_semantics.source_manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of the complete private per-case source-manifest bytes.

internal_seal_verification.algorithm: SHA-256 of canonical JSON (sorted keys and compact separators).
